info.description: Contract operations/1.1. Domain services remain authoritative. Request schemas are generated from runtime Zod schemas; omitted optional mutation schemas and response DTOs are described in docs/OPERATIONS.md. Binary upload limit 4 MiB. JSON input limit 64,000 bytes.
